title: lophozonia obliqua subsp. andina
intro: Lophozonia obliqua subsp. andina, commonly known as Chilean soursop, is a plant species of the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lophozonia obliqua subsp. andina include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
